OSSC CHSL Admit Card 2026 - Download Hall Ticket at ossc.gov.in - Complete Details

OSSC CHSL Admit Card 2026 will be released soon for the Preliminary Examination scheduled on 24 September 2026. Check admit card release status, download link, login details, exam date, and important instructions for 124 vacancies under Advt. No. 728/OSSC.

Important Dates

  • Exam Name : Combined Higher Secondary (10+2) Level or Equivalent Recruitment Examination for Specialist Posts/Services
  • Exam Stage : Preliminary Examination
  • Exam Mode : Computer-Based Recruitment Examination (CBRE)
  • Prelims Exam Date : September 24, 2026
  • Admit Card Status : Will be released Soon
  • Preliminary Exam Date : September 24, 2026
  • Admit Card Release Date : Will be released Soon

Application Fee

  • Posts : Amin, Junior Fisheries Technical Assistant, Junior Forensic Attendant

How to Download Admit Card

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the admit card / hall ticket link.
  3. Enter your registration number / roll number and date of birth / password.
  4. Click on submit to view your admit card.
  5. Download and take a printout. Carry it to the exam center along with a photo ID.
